t2.title: Society too focused on physical appearance
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Is society too focused on physical appearance?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
In today's image-obsessed culture, physical appearance seems to dominate. I believe society has become excessively focused on looks, with negative consequences.

Firstly, social media has intensified pressure to look perfect. Filtered photos and edited images create unrealistic beauty standards that cause body image issues, particularly among young people. Studies link this to increased rates of anxiety and depression.

Secondly, judging people by appearance leads to discrimination. Research shows attractive people often receive preferential treatment in jobs and relationships. This superficial assessment ignores important qualities like intelligence, kindness, and character.

However, caring about appearance isn't entirely negative. Personal grooming can boost confidence and self-esteem. The problem arises when external appearance becomes the primary measure of worth.

Furthermore, we should promote diverse beauty standards and celebrate different body types, ages, and features rather than one narrow ideal.

In conclusion, while appearance matters to some extent, society should value inner qualities equally. True beauty encompasses personality, actions, and character.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I go salon. It is ok. My hair is nice. I like face clean. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think people look too much at faces and hair. It is important but not the only thing. Some people are nice but not pretty. I like my hair after the salon. It is good. But I also want to be smart. My friend is very pretty and she is not nice. So, it is not good. Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
I think that society does focus too much on how people look. It's everywhere you see, like on TV and in magazines. Everyone wants to be beautiful, but it's not always possible or healthy.

For example, a lot of young people feel bad about themselves because they don't look like the models they see online. This can make them sad or even sick. Also, sometimes people are mean to others who don't look a certain way. This is not fair.

However, I also think it's okay to want to look good. Taking care of yourself can make you feel better. But it shouldn't be the most important thing in life. It is important to be a good person too.
t2.sampleB2: Great topic — this is something I've thought about a lot, so I'll jump straight in. In my opinion, society has definitely become too wrapped up in how people look. Everywhere you turn, from adverts to social media feeds, we're bombarded with images of so-called 'perfect' faces and bodies. The trouble is, most of these pictures are heavily edited, yet people still measure themselves against them and end up feeling like they don't quite match up. This constant pressure takes a real toll on young people especially. Many spend hours worrying about their appearance instead of focusing on things that actually matter, like their talents, friendships and health. That said, I don't think caring about how you look is a bad thing in itself. Making an effort can give your confidence a real boost — the problem only starts when looks become the be-all and end-all. At the end of the day, we should judge people by who they are, not what they look like. What do you all think? Has social media made this worse, or was it always like this? Cheers, Dilnoza Karimova
t2.uzSample:
Bugungi kunda tashqi ko'rinishga haddan tashqari e'tibor qaratiladigan madaniyatda, jismoniy ko'rinish ustunlik qiladiganga o'xshaydi. Menimcha, jamiyat tashqi ko'rinishga haddan tashqari e'tiborli bo'lib ketgan va buning salbiy oqibatlari mavjud.

Birinchidan, ijtimoiy tarmoqlar mukammal ko'rinishga bo'lgan bosimni kuchaytirdi. Filtrdan o'tgan fotosuratlar va tahrirlangan rasmlar noreal go'zallik standartlarini yaratadi, bu esa, ayniqsa, yoshlar orasida tana bilan bog'liq muammolarni keltirib chiqaradi. Tadqiqotlar buni xavotirlik va depressiya darajasining oshishi bilan bog'laydi.

Ikkinchidan, odamlarni tashqi ko'rinishi bo'yicha baholash kamsitishga olib keladi. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, jozibali odamlar ko'pincha ishda va munosabatlarda imtiyozli munosabatda bo'lishadi. Bu yuzaki baholash aql, mehribonlik va xarakter kabi muhim fazilatlarni e'tibordan chetda qoldiradi.

Biroq, tashqi ko'rinishga e'tibor berish butunlay salbiy emas. Shaxsiy parvarish o'ziga bo'lgan ishonchni va o'z-o'zini qadrlashni oshirishi mumkin. Muammo tashqi ko'rinish qadriyatning asosiy o'lchoviga aylanganda yuzaga keladi.

Bundan tashqari, biz xilma-xil go'zallik standartlarini targ'ib qilishimiz va bitta tor ideal o'rniga turli xil tana turlarini, yoshlarni va xususiyatlarni nishonlashimiz kerak.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, tashqi ko'rinish ma'lum darajada ahamiyatga ega bo'lsa-da, jamiyat ichki fazilatlarni ham teng qadrlashi kerak. Haqiqiy go'zallik shaxsiyatni, harakatlarni va xarakterni o'z ichiga oladi.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Men salonga boraman. Bu yaxshi. Sochim chiroyli. Menga yuzimning toza bo'lishi yoqadi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, odamlar yuz va sochga juda ko'p e'tibor berishadi. Bu muhim, lekin yagona narsa emas. Ba'zi odamlar yaxshi, lekin chiroyli emas. Menga sochlarim salondan keyin yoqadi. U yaxshi. Lekin men ham aqlli bo'lishni xohlayman. Mening do'stim juda chiroyli va u yaxshi emas. Shunday qilib, bu yaxshi emas. Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Menimcha, jamiyat odamlarning tashqi ko'rinishiga juda ko'p e'tibor qaratadi. Bu hamma joyda ko'rinadi, masalan, televizorda va jurnallarda. Hamma chiroyli bo'lishni xohlaydi, lekin bu har doim ham mumkin emas yoki sog'lom emas.

Misol uchun, ko'plab yoshlar o'zlarini yomon his qilishadi, chunki ular internetda ko'rgan modellarga o'xshamaydilar. Bu ularni xafa qilishi yoki hatto kasal qilishi mumkin. Shuningdek, ba'zida odamlar ma'lum bir ko'rinishga ega bo'lmaganlarga nisbatan yomon munosabatda bo'lishadi. Bu adolatdan emas.

Biroq, men ham yaxshi ko'rinishni xohlash yaxshi deb o'ylayman. O'zingizga g'amxo'rlik qilish o'zingizni yaxshi his qilishingizga yordam beradi. Lekin bu hayotdagi eng muhim narsa bo'lmasligi kerak. Yaxshi inson bo'lish ham muhim.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Menga shunday tuyuladiki, jamiyat tashqi ko'rinishga haddan tashqari e'tibor qaratmoqda. Shaxsiy taqdimot muhim bo'lsa-da, hozirgi e'tibor darajasi nomutanosib va potentsial jihatdan zararli.

Bunga asosiy sabablardan biri, shubhasiz, ijtimoiy tarmoqlardir. Doimiy ravishda saralangan rasmlar va noreal go'zallik standartlari, ayniqsa, yoshlar uchun bosimni yaratadi, bu esa tana obrazi bilan bog'liq muammolarga va past o'z-o'zini baholashga olib keladi. Misol uchun, filtrlar va tahrirlash vositalarining keng qo'llanilishi erishib bo'lmaydigan idealni targ'ib qiladi.

Bundan tashqari, tashqi ko'rinishga bo'lgan bu qiziqish kamsitish va diskriminatsiyaga olib kelishi mumkin. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, jozibali odamlar ko'pincha hayotning turli jabhalarida, jumladan, ish bilan ta'minlash va ijtimoiy munosabatlarda imtiyozli munosabatdan foyda ko'rishadi. Bu haqiqiy fazilatlar o'rniga yuzaki sifatlarga asoslangan adolatsiz ustunlikni yaratadi.

Albatta, o'z tashqi ko'rinishingizdan faxrlanish aslida salbiy emas. Biroq, tashqi tasdiqlash o'z-o'zini qadrlashning asosiy manbai bo'lganda, bu nosog'lom xatti-harakatlarga va qadriyatlarning buzilgan tuyg'usiga olib kelishi mumkin. Biz e'tiborni mehribonlik, aql va xarakter kabi ichki sifatlarga qaratishimiz kerak.

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the beauty salon. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear GlowUp Team, Thank you for asking about my recent visit to your beauty salon. I was extremely impressed with my experience. My stylist was highly skilled and took time to understand exactly what I wanted. The facial treatment was wonderfully relaxing, and the salon's ambiance was calm and luxurious. However, I have some suggestions. The appointment booking system was rather confusing online. A simpler booking platform with clear time slots would be helpful. Additionally, the waiting area felt slightly cramped when busy. I would love to see nail art services and organic skincare options added to your menu. A membership package with discounts for regular visits would also be attractive. Overall, I had a wonderful experience and will certainly return. Yours sincerely, Aziz Ergashev
t12.sampleA1:
Hi GlowUp!

It was good. Hair nice. Face good.

More colors? Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear GlowUp Team,

Thank you for the letter. I liked the salon. My hair is nice and my face feels good. The people are nice too.

But the music was loud and I didn't like it. And maybe you can have more magazines to read.

Thank you. Bye.
t12.sampleB1:
Dear GlowUp Team,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about my visit to your salon. I thought it was quite good. My hair looks nice, and the facial was relaxing. The staff were friendly and helpful.

However, I think there are some things you could improve. For example, the prices are a little high. Also, it was difficult to find parking near the salon.

I think it would be good if you offered more discounts for students. Also, maybe you could sell some of the skincare products you use in the salon.

Overall, I enjoyed my visit and I would probably come back again.

Sincerely,
Aziz Ergashev
t12.sampleB2: Dear GlowUp Team, Thank you for your kind message following my recent visit. I'm happy to share my thoughts on the experience. On the whole, I was thoroughly impressed. My stylist took the time to understand exactly what I was after, and the skincare treatment left my skin feeling noticeably fresher. The salon itself was calm and welcoming, which made the whole visit a real treat. That said, there is some room for improvement. The online booking system was rather fiddly, so a clearer layout with visible time slots would go a long way. I would also love to see organic skincare products and a loyalty scheme for regular customers. All in all, I had a lovely experience and will certainly be coming back. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli GlowUp jamoasi,

Go'zallik saloningizga yaqinda tashrif buyurganim haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Men olgan taassurotlarimdan juda mamnun bo'ldim. Mening stilistim juda mahoratli edi va men nima xohlayotganimni aniq tushunishga vaqt ajratdi. Yuz parvarishi juda yoqimli va dam beruvchi bo'ldi, salonning muhiti esa tinch va hashamatli edi.

Biroq, mening ba'zi takliflarim bor. Onlayn tarzda uchrashuvni bron qilish tizimi biroz chalkash edi. Aniq vaqt oralig'i ko'rsatilgan oddiyroq bron qilish platformasi foydali bo'lardi. Bundan tashqari, kutish xonasi gavjum paytlarda biroz tor bo'lib qolardi.

Men sizning menyuingizga tirnoqlarga rasm chizish xizmatlari va organik terini parvarishlash vositalari qo'shilishini xohlardim. Muntazam tashriflar uchun chegirmalar bilan a'zolik paketi ham jozibali bo'lardi.

Umuman olganda, men ajoyib tajribaga ega bo'ldim va albatta qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan, Aziz Ergashev

t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli GlowUp jamoasi,

Elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. Men sizga saloningizga tashrifim haqida aytmoqchi edim. Menimcha, u juda yaxshi edi. Sochlarim chiroyli ko'rinadi va yuzni tozalash juda yoqimli bo'ldi. Xodimlar do'stona va yordam berishga tayyor edilar.

Biroq, menimcha, siz yaxshilashingiz mumkin bo'lgan ba'zi narsalar bor. Masalan, narxlar biroz qimmat. Bundan tashqari, salon yaqinida mashina qo'yish joyini topish qiyin edi.

Menimcha, agar siz talabalar uchun ko'proq chegirmalar taklif qilsangiz yaxshi bo'lardi. Shuningdek, balki siz salonda ishlatadigan terini parvarishlash vositalarining ba'zilarini sotsangiz ham bo'ladi.

Umuman olganda, tashrifimdan mamnun bo'ldim va ehtimol yana qaytib kelaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Aziz Ergashev
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli GlowUp jamoasi,

Saloningizda yaqinda bo'lib o'tgan uchrashuvim haqidagi keyingi elektron pochtangiz uchun rahmat. O'z tajribam haqida ba'zi fikr-mulohazalarimni bildirishni istardim.

Umuman olganda, men olgan xizmatlardan mamnun bo'ldim. Stilist mening talablarimga e'tiborli edi va men oldindan batafsil maslahatlashuvni qadrladim. Terini parvarishlash muolajasi ham juda samarali bo'ldi va men terining tuzilishida sezilarli yaxshilanishni sezdim.

Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishlar kiritilishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, kutish joyi qulayroq o'tirish tartibidan foyda ko'rishi mumkin. Ikkinchidan, mahsulotlarni reklama qilish zarurligini tushunsam ham, uchrashuvim oxirida narsalarni sotib olishga biroz majburlanganimni his qildim.

Qo'shimcha xizmatlar nuqtai nazaridan, men sezgir teri uchun maxsus muolajalarni taklif qilish qimmatli qo'shimcha bo'ladi deb o'ylayman. Bundan tashqari, ehtimol, doimiy mijozlarni taqdirlash uchun sodiqlik dasturini amalga oshirishni ko'rib chiqishingiz mumkin.

Umuman olganda, men GlowUp-da ijobiy tajribaga ega bo'ldim va kelajakda qaytishni o'ylab ko'raman. Fikr-mulohazalarimga e'tiboringiz uchun rahmat.

Hurmat bilan,
Aziz Ergashev
